name: Battleworn Axe
summary: In Redridge, Battleworn Axe blades mark the Blackrock orcs invading the mountains. Marshal Marris accepts the recovered weapons in Lakeshire as proof of the threat to its people.

sections.title: Trophy of an Invader
sections.body: Blackrock reavers carry these heavy, nicked axes as they push south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge. Marshal Marris and Lakeshire's hard-pressed town watch collect the blades to confirm another marauding orc has fallen and to show how well armed the advancing warband is.

sections.title: The Threat in the Hills
sections.body: Blackrock invaders have fortified Stonewatch Keep and taken footholds in southeastern Redridge, trapping townspeople in Lakeshire. Taking their battleworn weapons reduces the arms available to the warband and clears roads for Alliance travel.

faq.answer: Blackrock orcs in the Redridge Mountains carry Battleworn Axes, rugged weapons worn by hard use. Recovered blades prove that invaders have been slain.

faq.q: Who wants these axes in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Marshal Marris, who commands Lakeshire's town guard, wants the axes as proof that the Blackrock threat is being pushed back from town lands.

faq.q: Where do these axes come from?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs throughout Redridge carry these axes, especially near Stonewatch Keep to the north and in orc encampments to the southeast.

faq.q: Why are the orcs in Redridge in the first place?
aliases: why are blackrock orcs in redridge
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan marched south through the mountain passes from the Burning Steppes, captured Stonewatch Keep, and marauded across northern and eastern Redridge to pin down Lakeshire.

angles.text: For the Alliance, each axe brought to Lakeshire marks one fewer invader threatening Redridge's exposed citizens while Stormwind's core forces are elsewhere.
As a blacksmith, you can see the resilient, heavy forging typical of Blackrock weapons in these crude iron blades, despite their jagged edges and chips.
